title: World Forum created by Mikhail Gorbachev, 1995-2000
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of World Forum created by Mikhail Gorbachev, 1995-2000, about 1995-2000; 2025-2030 at New York City, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says there was a World Forum created by Mikhail Gorbachev, the former Soviet leader, back in the 1990s. According to Bledsoe, it was a five-year event, running from 1995 to 2000, that ended in New York City when the ball dropped on New Year's Eve. He tells it as part of a wider story about powerful people and hidden plans.
